characters.name: Littlecourt
characters.description: A poor, bold, quick-witted boy who leaves home at birth, bargains for magical gifts, slays the three trolls, exposes Sir Red’s lie, and later rescues the elder princess from an undersea troll hall.
characters.look: A tiny, bold boy only days old but no bigger than a child of four, with the sturdy, natural proportions of a small child, a round face, rosy cheeks, a small button nose, big bright cornflower-blue eyes, a determined little chin and a mop of golden curls. An oversized knitted cap with blue-and-white stripes flops over one ear. He wears his big brothers' old rags: a far-too-big, much-patched grey-brown linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up, baggy patched brown breeches tied with string and big, worn-out leather shoes.

characters.name: Littlecourt in Gold
characters.description: Littlecourt in the garment of gold the princess dressed him in while he slept. He hides it under his rags until the wedding, where light shines from him.
characters.look: The same tiny, bold boy, no bigger than a child of four, with a round face, rosy cheeks, a small button nose, big bright cornflower-blue eyes, a determined little chin and a mop of golden curls under his oversized blue-and-white striped knitted cap. Now he wears a shining garment of pure gold that glows with its own light: a short, close-fitting gold tunic with a high collar and round gold buttons, gold hose and small gold shoes, with a golden-hilted sword in a plain brown sheath at his belt.

characters.name: King Lavring
characters.description: Littlecourt’s twin brother, identical in appearance, summoned in need and ultimately used to ensure both princesses are fairly matched through a clever exchange.
characters.look: A tiny, bold boy only days old but no bigger than a child of four, with exactly the same round face, rosy cheeks, small button nose, big bright cornflower-blue eyes and mop of golden curls as his twin brother, but with a cheeky, know-it-all grin. An oversized knitted cap with red-and-white stripes sits on his head. He wears his big brothers' old rags: a far-too-big, patched mustard-yellow wool jacket with the sleeves rolled up, baggy patched grey breeches tied with string and big wooden clogs.

characters.name: King Lavring in Littlecourt’s Clothes
characters.description: King Lavring dressed in his twin brother’s clothes, so alike that the princesses think it is Littlecourt coming in.
characters.look: The tiny twin dressed in his brother's clothes, so that nobody can tell the two apart: a bold boy no bigger than a child of four, with a round face, rosy cheeks, a small button nose, big bright cornflower-blue eyes and a mop of golden curls under an oversized blue-and-white striped knitted cap, in a shining garment of pure gold: a short, close-fitting gold tunic with a high collar and round gold buttons, gold hose and small gold shoes.

characters.name: The Younger Princess
characters.description: The king’s daughter promised to three trolls, saved by Littlecourt, and the one he truly chooses; she helps orchestrate the wedding-day reveal.
characters.look: A slim, lively princess of about eighteen with a round face, a pointed little chin, a small turned-up nose, big grey eyes, pale skin with pink cheeks and short, bouncy platinum-blonde curls. On her curls sits a small gold circlet shaped like a ring of oak leaves. She wears an emerald-green wool gown with long, narrow sleeves and a high round collar embroidered with tiny gold leaves, a thin gold belt and a string of small white pearls.

characters.name: The Elder Princess
characters.description: The King’s other daughter, carried off by a troll to his mountain at the bottom of the sea, where she sits sewing until Littlecourt comes. She is bigger and stronger than her sister.
characters.look: A tall, strong, broad-shouldered princess of about twenty-one, a head taller than her younger sister and quick on her feet, with a round face, a pointed chin, a small turned-up nose, big grey eyes, pink cheeks and thick platinum-blonde curls tumbling to her shoulders, held back with a string of pearls. She wears a long coral-red wool gown embroidered with little white seashells along the hem, a belt of plaited silver cord and a silver thimble on one finger.

characters.name: Sir Red
characters.description: A boastful court knight who hides in a tree during each troll’s arrival, threatens the princess into naming him as savior, and is finally exposed by proof and punished.
characters.look: A big, burly, barrel-chested knight of about forty, a head taller than most men, with a broad, puffy face that easily turns bright red, a big bulbous nose, small shifty pale-blue eyes under bushy brows, curly red hair and a huge, bushy fiery-red beard. He wears polished steel armour over a red tunic, a long bright-red cloak and heavy boots, and always has a big white handkerchief tucked into his belt.

characters.name: The One-Eyed Hag
characters.description: An old, old hag, bent double, with only one eye. Littlecourt meets three of them, and to get their eyes back they give him a sword, a ship and the knack of brewing.
characters.look: A tiny, ancient hag, no taller than a small child and bent double so that her back curves like a hook, with a small, deeply wrinkled face like a walnut, a flat little nose, a wide toothless mouth and only one eye: a single round, shiny sky-blue eye in the middle of her forehead. Her thin white hair is in a tiny knot. She wears a long, faded lavender homespun dress and a big brown fringed shawl, and leans on a crooked stick.

characters.name: The King
characters.description: The King at the manor by the sea, who has promised one daughter to three sea trolls and lost the other to a troll under the sea.
characters.look: A jolly, stocky king of about sixty with a big round belly, a broad, ruddy face made for laughing, a bulbous nose, crinkly brown eyes, bushy chestnut-brown eyebrows, thick chestnut curls and a big, round, curly chestnut-brown beard clipped short like a bush. He wears a tall gold crown with seven points, each tipped with a round amber bead, a long rust-orange wool robe with a wide brown fur collar, a gold belt and soft brown boots.

characters.name: The Kitchen Maid
characters.description: The kitchen maid at the manor, for whom Littlecourt carries wood and water, and who gets armful after armful of gold and silver hoops.
characters.look: A sturdy, cheerful kitchen maid of about eighteen with a broad, rosy, round face, merry dark-brown eyes, a snub nose dusted with flour and thick black hair wound into a bun under a white linen kerchief. Her sleeves are rolled up over strong arms. She wears a long cornflower-blue homespun dress and a big white apron with soup stains, and keeps a large wooden ladle tucked into her apron strings.

characters.name: The Five-Headed Troll
characters.description: The first of the three sea trolls the princess was promised to. It comes storming in from the sea with five heads and a great thick iron bar.
characters.look: A huge, bloated sea troll about five times as tall as a man, with dusky purple-grey skin like an old mussel shell, crusted with barnacles and hung with strands of dark seaweed, a great sagging belly, long dangling arms and flat, webbed feet. It has exactly five heads on five thick, wrinkled necks, each with a long drooping nose, small round yellow eyes and a tuft of shaggy grey hair. It wears a kilt of old brown fishing net and carries a thick iron bar.

characters.name: The Ten-Headed Troll
characters.description: The second sea troll to come for the princess, twice as big as the first, with ten heads.
characters.look: An enormous sea troll about ten times as tall as a man, with rough slate-blue skin, knobbly and shiny like wet rock, a broad, square body, short thick legs and huge webbed feet. It has exactly ten round heads in two rows of five, one row above the other, each with a flat nose, big goggling green eyes, a wide frog mouth and a scraggly grey beard. It wears a torn black sail wrapped around its middle and carries a huge iron bar.

characters.name: The Fifteen-Headed Troll
characters.description: The third and biggest sea troll, with fifteen heads and an iron bar that sends the earth flying fifteen yards into the air.
characters.look: The biggest sea troll of all, as tall as a hill, with dark peat-brown, lumpy skin like a bog, shaggy grey hair on its shoulders, a round belly and legs like old tree stumps. It has exactly fifteen heads stacked in a pyramid, five on its shoulders, then four, three, two and one on top, each with a round red nose, small blinking amber eyes and a shock of grey hair. It wears a huge patched sailcloth tunic tied with a ship's rope and carries a gigantic iron bar.

characters.name: The Troll under the Sea
characters.description: The troll who carried the elder princess off to his mountain at the bottom of the sea. He is so savage-tempered he tears people to pieces, but he badly wants strong ale for his feast.
characters.look: A fat, savage-tempered troll about three times as tall as a man, with smooth, shiny turquoise skin like a wet fish, a barrel belly, short bowed legs and big flat webbed feet. He has one huge head with a gigantic, wrinkly, trumpet-shaped nose that is always sniffing, bulging pale-orange eyes, bristly orange eyebrows and a long tangle of brown kelp for hair and beard. He wears baggy patched sailcloth breeches held up by a rope and a necklace of big shells.

places.look: A wide, pale sandy beach below the royal manor, curving along the open sea. Right at the water's edge lies one big, flat, grey boulder, and at the top of the beach stands a huge, gnarled old oak with wide, spreading branches and yellow-brown autumn leaves. places.name: the Great Hall
places.look: A long, high hall of dark, honey-brown logs with carved pillars, painted rosemaling on the ceiling beams, small leaded windows along one side and a big stone fireplace at the far end. One very long plank table with benches runs down the middle, with a tall carved chair at its head. Iron candle-crowns hang from the beams, and a few black hangings are still left on the walls.

places.name: the Hall under the Sea
places.look: A vast, rough cave hall inside a rock mountain at the bottom of the sea, with dark blue-grey rock walls hung with seaweed and shells, and a smooth stone floor. A huge stone oven with a chimney glows red at one end, with two enormous wooden brewing vats and barrels beside it. A small closet with a plank door is set into one wall, and a heavy round door opens onto the green sea.
